_comment: The 2026-09-26 root run, reduced to the session that misscored.
The kernel refused a datagram to 1.1.1.1:53 - the run's own violations list held
'socket_sendmsg: denied outbound datagram to unapproved IPv4 1.1.1.1' - but the VIOLATION frame
never reached the udp-outside session, so a check that read frame delivery alone scored the
denial as absent. The EXIT receipt carried the kernel's own per-cgroup count and said the count
This fixture is that shape: an EXIT whose violationsCounted is 1 and violationsComplete is true,
with NO VIOLATION frame in the session. udp_outside_the_lease_blocked must be true and
udp_violation_frame_reached_the_session must be false - the denial proven, the lost frame still
visible. Before 2026-09-27 the first of those was false and the second did not exist.
